firm_data.firm_description: Danzi Law Partners LLP is a team of dedicated trial lawyers who have been advocating in medical malpractice and wrongful death cases for more than three decades. The firm focuses exclusively on representing individuals who have sustained serious injuries or lost loved ones due to negligence.
notable_facts: Attorneys at the firm have over 150 years of combined experience.
Achieved many multi-million-dollar verdicts and settlements for clients.
Robert F. Danzi earned an AV Preeminent rating from Martindale-Hubbell.

email.subject: AI for Danzi Law Partners, built for trial firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Robert,

With over 150 years of combined experience focused on medical malpractice and wrongful death cases, your team has built something most firms can't: deep expertise paired with efficiency. That combination matters more now than ever.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by your Jericho office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping trial firms compete with larger competitors.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
